title: Select-only pattern
text: Follows the WAI-ARIA select-only combobox pattern with a popup in the top layer.

title: Typeahead
text: Typing letters jumps to the matching option.

title: Option descriptions
text: Options can carry a description or be disabled.

title: Custom rendering
text: Render your own content for options and the selected value.

title: Form ready
text: Submits through a hidden input with localized required validation.
